findings: Both named upstream WoW64 prerequisites are verified merged: PR #8713 (kernel prep, merged 2026-08-06) and PR #9766 (sdk/include/ndk/kbd.h prep, merged 2026-11-07).
PR #8713 is an ancestor of all eight investigated nitroos-org 3b/3c tip commits (compare behind_by=0).
PR #9766 is NOT an ancestor of any of the eight tips (all compare status=diverged, behind_by=260); the tips are dated 2026-10-14 and predate the 2026-11-07 merge.

All eight tip SHAs resolve in the reactos/reactos object store but none is merged into current master: every compare against master returns status=diverged with 1346-1374 ahead and 369 behind relative to merge base 3e6033a613fbf7c5bd58aaeaa05af42514af59d5. This independently confirms the W2-01 clarification that exact-SHA membership is not master ancestry.

The fork branch work spans win32ss, wow64win, user32 and WoW64 apitests, which is distinct from the files touched by #8713 (ntoskrnl) and #9766 (SDK kbd.h); the merged prerequisites are necessary but do not cover the fork's WoW64 GUI/thunk work.
No patch-equivalence test, build, or runtime test was performed; no code was imported and no branch was pushed, merged or submitted upstream.
next_step_for_future_mandate: If an implementation mandate is ever authorized, rebase the 3b/3c line onto a master that includes #9766 and the 369 newer commits, then run focused WoW64 GUI/callback tests before any adoption; route A licensing review required for any reused GPL-2.0-or-later code.
